components.css: .ds-submit { width: 100%; height: 50px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #2f5bd3); color: var(--accent-ink, #ffffff); font: 600 1rem/1.5 "Figtree Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-submit:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #2f5bd3) 88%, #000000); } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bd3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Name Field

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 "Figtree Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #18181b); max-width: 16rem; } .ds-field em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-3, #71717a); } .ds-field input { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--taken, #d4d4d8); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ground, #ffffff); font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Figtree Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #71717a); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #2f5bd3); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #2f5bd3) 22%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-sheet { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Figtree Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); } .ds-num, .ds-state, .ds-range { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-3, #71717a); } .ds-range { min-height: 36px; } .ds-you { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #2f5bd3) 7%, #ffffff); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bd3); } .ds-you .ds-num { color: var(--accent, #2f5bd3); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-draft { min-width: 0; padding-right: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink-2, #52525b); } .ds-rule { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 1fr; align-items: end; padding: 18px 0 6px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line-strong, #18181b); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2, #52525b); } .ds-rule span { grid-column: 2; }

components.css: .ds-sheet-signed { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Figtree Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-you-signed { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #2f5bd3) 7%, #ffffff); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bd3); } .ds-you-signed .ds-num { color: var(--accent, #2f5bd3); font-weight: 700; } .ds-name { display: block; font-weight: 600; animation: ds-write 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2, #52525b); } @keyframes ds-write { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-name { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Capacity is drawn as a numbered sheet. Every seat is a line with its number in a fixed column, taken lines say so, long runs collapse into one range line, and a heavy ink rule marks where capacity ends and the waitlist begins. The attendee sees exactly which line is theirs before they act, writes their email on it, and watches their name fill that same line on submit. The number never moves.

The world is neutral on purpose. A tenant themes the whole app by overriding one token, the accent, and everything else stays white ground, a zinc ink scale and hairline rules. Density is calm: one reading-width column on every viewport, 48px lines, no decoration. The visual vocabulary is rules, numbers and weight. Depth, imagery and color fields are absent.

The system covers the event list (`/`) and the registration page (`/events/$eventId`). `/integrations` is intentionally unstyled and is not yet brought into the system. Its markup carries no classes, and the stylesheet resets margins per class so that page keeps browser defaults.
keyCharacteristics: One themeable accent, reserved for the attendee's own line, its number and the submit button.
Hairline rows, one strong ink rule for boundaries.
Figtree throughout with tabular numerals in a fixed number column.
Flat white ground. Shadows appear only as focus rings.
One 34rem column on phone and desktop alike.

rules.name: The Own Line Rule
rules.body: The accent marks what belongs to the attendee: their line, its number, the button that claims it, and the browser surfaces they are acting through (focus, caret, selection). Links, hover states, counts, status lines and headings never take the accent.

rules.name: The One Token Rule
rules.body: A tenant themes the app by overriding `--accent` alone. Every accent tint (wash, selection, focus rings, button hover) is a `color-mix` of `--accent`, never a separate literal.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on the body). Numbers sit in a fixed column: the 3.25rem number column on the sheet, a right-aligned 7.5rem minimum column on the event list.

rules.name: The Weight Not Color Rule
rules.body: Inside a neutral line, emphasis is weight 600 to 700 in Ink against 400 in Ink 2 or Ink 3 ("**20** of 20 open"). Color stays reserved for the accent.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Phone and desktop render the same reading-width column. Wider viewports add margin, not columns.

rules.name: The Ruled Sheet Rule
rules.body: Depth is never used to group or lift content. Hairlines separate, strong ink marks a boundary, and the accent rule marks ownership.

dos: Do theme a tenant by overriding `--accent` only, and derive every accent tint with `color-mix` from it.
Do keep the accent on the attendee's own line, its number, the submit button and browser focus, caret and selection surfaces.
Do put numbers in a fixed tabular column (3.25rem on the sheet, right-aligned 7.5rem on lists).
Do separate rows with 1px `--line` hairlines and mark a real boundary with `--line-strong`.
Do keep every page in the single 34rem column with 20px gutters.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing the write reveal and the button transition.
donts: Don't use the accent for links, hover states, counts, headings or status text.
Don't add cover images, avatars or social proof.
Don't add paper texture or handwriting costume to the sheet. It is drawn with rules and numbers only.
Don't put an event in a centered card with a muted seats line and a black button.
Don't add shadows or cards for grouping. Box shadows are for focus only.
Don't use Danger for anything except the registration error.
